author: sjm41
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**
IPR001806 Small GTPase

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Dmel RhoGAPp190 (Q9VX32)
Human ARHGAP35 (Q9NRY4)
etc

* **Description of issue**
The RhoGAPp190 proteins are GTPase activators (GAPs) and lack GTPase activity - e.g. see PMID: 30174148.
However, they match the IPR001806 entry and thereby get annotated with 'GTPase activity'.

Seems best to remove the annotation from IPR001806 and ensure that the child entries (shown below) have it instead whenever appropriate (and where that's not already the case)?
Ran GTPase (IPR002041)
Small GTPase Rho (IPR003578)
Small GTPase Tem1/Spg1 (IPR017231)
Ras-related small G protein, RGK family (IPR017358)
Small GTPase, Ras-type (IPR020849)
Mitochondrial Rho GTPase (IPR021181)
Ras-related protein Rab29/Rab38/Rab32 (IPR030697)
Rab3 (IPR037872)
Ciliogenesis and planar polarity effector 2 (IPR039677)
Rab33A/B (IPR041822)
Rab9 (IPR041824)
Rab15 (IPR041826)
Rab24 (IPR041828)
Rab12 (IPR041830)
Rab21 (IPR041833)
Rab-like protein 2 (IPR041835)
Rab20 (IPR041836)
Rab27a/b (IPR041837)
NF-kappa-B inhibitor-interacting Ras-like protein (IPR042227)
Membrane trafficking Rab GTPases (IPR050209)
Ras-related protein Rab (IPR050227)
title: InterPro2GO issue: IPR001806 Small GTPase

author: sarach06
body:
Hi Steven, 
Thank you very much for this. I have reviewed all these entries and added the GTPase term when suitable (some entries already had it, some needed to be added and in a few cases I didn't add the term as the proteins don't have the activity or ther eis not sufficient evidence), and I removed it from IPR001806. These changes will be available in InterPro release 111.0.

Best wishes,
Sara

author: sjm41
body: Great, thanks Sara! (and for your work on my other tickets too!)
